name: Wetown Electric Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Wetown Electric Group Co., Ltd., established in 1986 and headquartered in Yangzhong, China, is a global enterprise dedicated to the research, development, manufacturing, and sale of a comprehensive range of electrical products. The company's operations span across China, Southeast Asia, Australia, South America, Africa, and other international markets. Its diverse product portfolio includes advanced busway systems (covering low, high voltage, wind, nuclear, and resin casting applications) and various electrical distribution solutions, such as high and low voltage switchgear, box-type substations, and distribution boxes. It also produces components vital for the photovoltaic module industry, including welding belts and fluxes. Beyond finished goods, the group supplies fundamental raw materials like copper and aluminum for bus bar manufacturing, as well as tin-coated copper strips for solar modules. Innovative new material products for infrastructure are also offered, encompassing embedded channels for rail transit, pipe gallery supports, anti-seismic suspension systems, and photovoltaic supports. Complementing these, Wetown Electric provides comprehensive cable management systems, including steel, aluminum alloy, and data center cable trays, alongside mesh trays, optical fiber channels, wiring frames, and wire fixers. These solutions cater to an extensive client base across numerous sectors, such as critical infrastructure (government buildings, power generation, petrochemicals, rail transit), industrial applications (ferrous metallurgy, machinery, automotive), and commercial/public services (financial real estate, hotels, hospitals, IT, data centers, communications). Its offerings further support industries like tobacco, paper, food, transportation, textiles, and the growing photovoltaic sector.
